title: Add a test that `idefactory ci scaffold` in a temporary consumer checkout which already has `.factory/team.md` and no consumer workflow writes `.github/workflows/factory-consumer.yml` there, does not call the forge, does not create the file in this repository, and leaves this repository's `ci.yml` and `release.yml` byte-for-byte unchanged. Do not use init to produce the missing file, because init now creates it. Verify with `node --test test/consumer-ci-scaffold.test.mjs`. The command already writes an absent file; the test must pass without a second writer.
acceptanceCriteria: An existing consumer checkout receives the workflow from ci scaffold.
